summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K reporting an auditor change, not a special situation. On September 17, 2026, the Audit and Risk Management Committee recommended, and the Board approved, the resignation of Zeifmans LLP as independent registered public accounting firm, effective September 29, 2026. The same day, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP was appointed auditor until the next annual shareholders meeting. The filing states there were no disagreements, reportable events, or modified opinions for fiscal 2025 and 2024. This mirrors a Canadian Form 51-102F5 change-of-auditor notice mapped to a US current report. No deal terms apply.
